changes: OpenAI shipped GPT-6.1 Terra (2026-10-26, now GA in the API and Microsoft Foundry) with no cyber evaluation numbers published yet, while Moonshot's K3.1 Pro chart gave us the first cross-model scores on its internal exploit benchmark — showing open-weight DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (85.7) ahead of Moonshot's deliberately cyber-curbed model (81.0). Three new agentic-attack incidents land this week (CrowdStrike's four exposed agent frameworks, TrendAI's 44-agent CyberStrikeAI campaign against Japan, and 123 Reg's disclosed 'AI cyberattack'), and Google's Gemini 4 Argon card concedes it cannot rule out hitting its Cyber Uplift Level 1 threshold.
incident: CrowdStrike documents four previously unreported agentic-AI attack campaigns
incident: CyberStrikeAI: 44-agent open-source attack platform used against Japanese organizations
incident: 123 Reg discloses AI-driven attack on customer data, suspects China nexus
